title: Firehouse job and jam sessions with captain and lieutenant
summary: Zanco is a fireman at Central Station in the French Quarter, with free time. Captain Martin Finity (banjo) and Lieutenant Sidney Del Paget (drums) play with him at the firehouse.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: Before you go on, I think we ought to put down Moose's job, what he does for the life. Yeah. Tell him what you want.
Well, I'm a fireman on the New Orleans Fire Department. I've been on that job now six years.
I'm at Central Fire Station right on Decatur Street in the heart of the French Quarter. Pass that large ass trail, Pa.
Thank you. Well, since this is gonna be something concerning Austria, maybe I should say Docker. Dunker. Anyway, uh, what do you do in the fire department there? What's your job business
cleaning quarters up. Occasionally you do make a fire, you know.
But you have some time on your hands.
Oh yeah, I have quite a lot of time.
Well, who plays down there, the banjo playing piano players?

Well, they had this captain by the name of Martin Finity. He used to be a banjo player years ago. And when I decided to bring my horn around the firehouse one day, he said he would bring his banjo. So between the two of us, we'd worked up a duet. So in the meantime, this other fella, he's a lieutenant by the name of Del Paget, Sidney Del Paget. He's the drummer. He can't buy what he said. Incidentally, Del Paget used to play with this Evolution Trio that was the craze of New Orleans many years ago. He played with the Evolution Trio. Of course, that was before my time, but they tell me they were great.
I don't think I met him. He wasn't there the night I was down there.

I don't believe it, no. That's probably the first drummer you've ever seen with two fingers off his right hand. But he was terrific. And, oh, occasionally other fellas would drop in, you know, and we'd get a little session going. You know, just by our own amusement. I mean, a firehouse can get to be a pretty dead place, you know. And we'd get a little session going just by our own kicks.
